name: 🦆 RAISE a DUCKY 🦆
desc:
👍LIKE FOR NEW UPDATES👍

⭐JOIN THE GROUP FOR 50 FREE POINTS⭐

Best played with friends!

🦆 Raising a duck has never been so accurately simulated than ever before!

♥ TAKE CARE of your duck by feeding it, providing it with entertainment and shelter, giving it more ducky friends, and taking it out for a walk!
One issue, you're locked inside. 

🌐 THROUGH THE WORLD-WIDE INTERNET, you can order items directly into your home to provide the correct necessities for your duck! 

⚔ BATTLE Raiders & Intruders to keep your duck safe! Be careful though, we heard that once you get out, something evil comes in..

🔧 PROGRESS through the game through ESSENTIALS and escape to the NEXT LEVEL!

One rule, don't let your duck run out of hunger... EVER!
